messages:
Ava: Quick UX/a11y: when scrubbing the timeline VoiceOver announces the snapshot then the variant pill, so it sounds duplicated: 'Snapshot July 7 12:00. Canary 20%. Snapshot July 7 12:00.' :thinking:
Tom: Repro on macOS/Safari. Both scrubber focus and pill aria-live fire. NVDA doesn't duplicate.
Leah: Proposal: single sr-only announcer owned by the scrubber; make pill aria-live only update on allocation changes, not on focus.
Marco: Also microcopy: rollback modal primary CTA is "Confirm". Please change to "Rollback to snapshot" and include snapshot id in aria-label.
Ava: And change inline action "Pause rollout" to "Pause canary" to avoid confusing customers that think whole deployment pauses.
Tom: I'll open a small PR: 1) scrubber sr-only announcer, 2) pill live-region debounce, 3) copy updates for pause/rollback. Feature-flag and add VoiceOver/NVDA checklist.
Leah: Add unit + e2e asserting only scrubber announces on focus. I'll run VoiceOver once flag is on.
A11yBot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-2026-001 duplicate-announcement (medium).
Ava: Thanks — quick follow-up test planned after PR.
